name: Ningbo Ronbay New Energy Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Ronbay New Energy Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of multi-materials, lithium iron phosphate materials, sodium electric materials and multi-material precursors in China and internationally. The company's products are used in energy vehicles, energy storage batteries, electric two-wheelers and consumer electronics products.
